packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time Library first viewport has a readable dark route heading, contained filter area, and no giant blank/low-contrast hero region on desktop or mobile.

title: Operations Library First Viewport Readability

reasons: Manual review of the latest 80-screenshot audit found the Operations Library desktop first viewport still has a giant empty dark region and low-contrast One Time Library heading.
The renderer uses the generic content page heading inside the dark One Time shell, which automated checks did not classify as a finding.

The fix is scoped to One Time Operations Content / One Time Library presentation only, with no content data, publishing, upload, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, social, email, or external provider behavior change.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this library first-viewport cleanup, rerun full audit and continue only if manual review finds another concrete defect or deploy/live-smoke becomes available.

operator_intent_summary: Fix the remaining One Time Library first-viewport visual defect so the page loads cleanly with readable heading copy and contained filters instead of a low-contrast dark blank area.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No backend authorization, allowed-view policy, database query, route registry, action registry, payment, email, access grant, account, DNS, send, publish, upload, or external-provider mutation.
No GHL runtime, LeadConnector runtime, external CRM client, or external CRM write.
No removal of diagnostic support routes used by Shloimie/Codex; this packet only demotes them from the primary Rabbi sidebar.

inspection_targets: public/operations.html workspaceNavViewIds, workspaceNavItems, renderSidebar, renderSidebarModuleList, currentNavItem, switchView, setCurrentSection
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: Desktop Operations Library screenshot shows a large empty dark first-viewport region before useful library cards.
The One Time Library heading and description are low contrast against the dark One Time shell.
The open filter panel sits as a bright floating column and makes the first viewport feel unbalanced rather than clean.

expanded_phrases.clean: The One Time Library first viewport should immediately explain what Rabbi is looking at and show useful library status/content, not a dark empty gap with barely visible heading text.
expanded_phrases.even: Primary modules should use consistent short labels, markers, section targets, and active states across desktop and mobile.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The first rendered Operations viewport should expose the relevant One Time modules without a long platform-module wall or layout jump.
expanded_phrases.CRM: Interpret CRM as first-party BNA/One Time contact review UX only: list/detail review, no-send state, dedupe state, source provenance, communication readback, and guarded direct actions. Do not add GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM APIs, or external CRM writes.
expanded_phrases.community section: Community/class work remains first-party One Time classroom/community data and may be grouped under Rabbi modules without cross-workspace record bleed.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use the existing Rabbi IA and first-party BNA Operations routes. Support modules remain routable for diagnostics but are demoted from the Rabbi-facing primary sidebar.

requirements.statement: Fix the One Time Operations Library first viewport so the route heading, description, filters, and first useful content load cleanly and readably on desktop and mobile.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a compact/readable One Time Library heading surface, contained filters, and useful library status/content visible without a giant blank or low-contrast hero region.
acceptance_criteria: The content route marks One Time Library state for scoped styling without affecting other content sections or non-One Time workspaces.
One Time Library page heading and description use readable light text on a contained dark panel.
Desktop first viewport no longer has a giant blank dark region before library status/cards.
Filters remain accessible and contained; mobile has no horizontal overflow.
No content publishing, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, upload, email, social, payment, access, external provider, GHL, or LeadConnector behavior changes.

criteria: Latest 80-screenshot audit exists and manual review identified a specific One Time Library first-viewport defect.
Operations Library code path and One Time scoped CSS are identified.
The change can stay in frontend presentation only.
